about_short_description.short_description: Alice tech is the developer of an artificial intelligence-powered study platform designed to personalize the learning experience.

product.name: Alice Study Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform that converts uploaded study materials into personalized notes, summaries, and exercises to support individual learning needs.

product.name: AI Chat Function
product.description: An interactive AI chat feature that allows students to engage with their study notes and receive explanations and guidance.

product.name: Personalized Exercises
product.description: A set of customizable exercises including multiple choice questions, flashcards, open questions, and exam simulators to test knowledge and reinforce learning.

product.name: Educator Tools
product.description: Features designed for teachers to upload, customize, and manage course materials, track student progress, and prevent plagiarism.
